additions.instrument: Partner-pack delivery register and distribution log

measurement.counted_event: Each partner proof pack delivery recorded during the measurement period when the pack is sent, published, handed over or otherwise made available to an intended referral partner, ecosystem partner or enterprise-buyer route, with observable evidence of the delivery event, period and recipient or channel scope.
measurement.exclusions: Exclude draft packs, prepared but undelivered packs, approvals, later downloads, later briefings, duplicate delivery records for the same pack delivery in the same instrument scope, failed sends, inaccessible links and deliveries of unrelated assets. Do not exclude eligible partner pack deliveries because the recipient did not download, attend a briefing, refer a lead or meet unrelated campaign quality requirements.

additions.instrument: Published-asset register and campaign distribution log

measurement.counted_event: Each campaign asset recorded as sent or published during the measurement period for The Stop Line or Signed by Humans, including proof pages, founder posts, partner material, technical proof stories, social-pack posts, earned outreach assets, employee advocacy posts, scorecards or approved toolkit assets when the register shows the asset reached its intended public, partner, employee, sales or owned-channel audience.
measurement.exclusions: Exclude drafts, prepared assets, approvals, internal-only review copies, duplicate publication records for the same asset in the same channel and period, failed sends or failed page loads, and records that cannot identify the asset and publication channel. Do not exclude eligible published assets because they later received no downloads, briefings, engagement, proof-page visits, meetings, leads or unrelated campaign-governance results.
